briefdescription.para: Detailed documentation for the AnalysisG::analysis class.

detaileddescription.para: This file provides comprehensive technical documentation for the AnalysisG::analysis class, covering its purpose, internal mechanisms, member variables, and public/private member functions. The analysis class serves as the core orchestrator for the entire analysis workflow within the bsm4tops-gnn-analysis framework, managing data loading, event and graph building, selection application, metric calculation, and model training/inference.
